findings.issue: Floor-1 /render endpoint has no PDP gate. `actor` is extracted then voided (`void actor`). `renderFloor1` does not receive actor or authzDeps and does not call `checkReadGrant`. Comment claims 'checked by PDP inside renderFloor1 via withTenantTx' but withTenantTx only enforces RLS tenant isolation, not application-read authorization. ADR §6 requires `read` on `application` for page view — this applies to both Floor-1 and Floor-2 endpoints.
findings.suggestion: Pass actor, nowMs, and authzDeps into renderFloor1. Call authzDeps.checkReadGrant before withTenantTx (mirror pattern from dataFloor2 lines 634-637). Add AC-10-FLOOR1 test: non-genesis without application read grant → 403.

findings.issue: defaultCheckReadGrant uses the wrong grant pool. `loadAdminContext` (org.ts:456) loads only grants with `resource_type LIKE 'mgmt_object:%'`. The condition `g.delegable && g.operation === 'read'` checks for a mgmt_object:* grant with operation 'read', which does not exist in the system (mgmt_object operations are author/promote/apply, not read). This means all non-genesis users are denied regardless of their `application read` grant. ADR §6 requires checking grant `read` on resource_type `application` via PDP T-0021, not via loadAdminContext.adminGrants. Also missing: no `resource_type` filter on the grant (no check that g.resourceType === 'application').
findings.suggestion: Replace defaultCheckReadGrant with a correct PDP path that queries application read grants (not mgmt_object:* grants). Add a live DB test: non-genesis user WITH application read grant → 200; without → 403.

findings.issue: AC-6 (NO_READ_GRANT for Floor-2) is listed in the file header comment but has no live DB test implementation. The unit test (src/__tests__/report-page-render.test.ts AC-6) uses injected denyDeps mock — it does not test the real defaultCheckReadGrant behavior. Combined with R-2, the broken PDP gate is invisible to CI.
findings.suggestion: Add live DB probe for AC-6 in ci/checks/db/report_page_render.test.ts: seed a non-genesis user, create a floor=2 page, call /data without application read grant → 403; with grant → 200.

findings.issue: FIELD_KEY_SAFE_RE includes hyphen `-` (`[a-zA-Z0-9_-]`). Hyphen in a jsonb field_key is technically valid in PostgreSQL and causes no injection risk (charset guard blocks SQL metacharacters). Minor: most registry_def schemas use underscores not hyphens. No security concern.
findings.suggestion: Consider documenting intentional inclusion of `-` in a comment, or restrict to `[a-zA-Z0-9_]+` if product convention disallows hyphens in field keys.

findings.issue: AC-6 unit test passes empty FakePool `makeFakePool([])` with denyDeps. Since denyDeps fires before any pool touch, this is currently safe but fragile — if logic changes to need pool before authz check, the empty pool would silently mask issues.
findings.suggestion: Add comment: '// denyDeps fires before pool connect — empty pool is safe here'.

role_gap_evidence: R-2 reveals a systematic PDP pattern gap: loadAdminContext is designed for mgmt_object:* admin checks (authoring, promoting), not for resource-level read grants (application read). The render module needs a separate PDP path for `application read` that is currently absent from the codebase. This is a candidate for dedicated security-reviewer attention or explicit PDP T-0021 extension: SQ11 ledger item.
